planets.name: HD 63433 c
planets.description: HD 63433 c crosses its star every 20.5 days and is 2.7 times as wide as Earth, found in 2020.

text.card: HD 63433 c was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 63433. Its orbit and size follow Mallorquín et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
